KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Hears or says /d/ for /t/, so tamu (sweet) becomes damu (blood).

example.question: Mwalimu anasema: "tamu". Umesikia neno lipi?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: p/b, t/d, k/g and ch/j are made at the same place in the mouth and differ only in voice; Kalenjin languages, for example, do not separate them, so the child hears one sound and writes either letter.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema: "tamu". Umesikia neno lipi?" with "damu" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the pair slowly with a hand on the throat (or watching the lips); the child says which word was heard before writing.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "tamu" ina sauti /t/. "damu" ni neno lingine lenye maana nyingine.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Writes the word with the letter of the other sound (goti where koti is meant).

example.question: Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "a coat".

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child spells as he speaks; if the two sounds are one sound in his speech, the letter is a guess.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "a coat"." with "goti" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Pair each spelling with its meaning on a card; the child sorts the cards by meaning, then by letter.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Neno lenye maana ya "a coat" ni "koti". "goti" lina maana ya "a knee".
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Thinks the two words are one word said in two ways, with one meaning.

example.question: "koti" na "goti" ni maneno yenye maana moja?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child has heard both said by different people for the same thing and takes the difference for an accent.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question ""koti" na "goti" ni maneno yenye maana moja?" with "ndiyo" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Use both words in two sentences that cannot swap: the child says which sentence breaks.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Hapana. "koti" ni a coat, na "goti" ni a knee.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Takes any long sentence for a kitanzandimi, though it does not repeat the target sounds.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
example.correct_answer: Baba na bibi wanapika pilau na pombe ya bibi bila pilipili.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child thinks a kitanzandimi is any sentence that is hard to say, not one built by repeating close sounds.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?" with "Mama amerudi nyumbani jioni." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Underline the target sounds in the real kitanzandimi; count them; the ordinary sentence has few or none.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama p/b, t/d, k/g na ch/j, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Breaks the word into syllables at the wrong place, so the target sound is lost (ta-mu read as two wrong parts).

example.question: Neno "tamu" lina silabi zipi?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: In Kiswahili every syllable ends in a vowel, and a nasal with its consonant (nd, mb, nj, ng) starts one syllable; the child splits by letters, not by sound.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "tamu" lina silabi zipi?" with "t-amu" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the nasal goes with the consonant after it.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ta-mu.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T1_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, neno "mche" lina maana gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child goes by the first letters.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kufanana kwa umbo na yasiwe na maana sawa. Mche ni mmea mchanga wa kupanda, si mchele.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Picks a word from the same sentence, not the word asked.

example.question: Katika kifungu, neno "kuchemsha" lina maana gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child picks the meaning of a nearby action.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: The meaning of the word next to it as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.help: Put each meaning in place of the word. Which one fits?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Jaribu kila maana mahali pa neno hilo. Maana sahihi ndiyo inayofaa sentensi nzima.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Picks the opposite of the word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, neno "madonge" lina maana gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child knows what the word is about but not which way it points.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: The opposite meaning as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.help: Read the sentence again: does it say the thing is there or not?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Maana ya neno hutegemea sentensi lilimotumika. Madonge ni vipande vilivyoshikana, si unga laini.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Names the wrong person from the story.

example.question: Nani alimwita Achieng sokoni?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child goes by the name that comes first in the passage.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A question about who, with other people in the story.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Find the sentence that names the person who did it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Kifungu kinasema nani alifanya kitendo hicho. Soma sentensi hiyo tena.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives an answer from what the child knows, not from the passage.

example.question: Achieng alinunua nini sokoni?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child answers from life and does not look in the text.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A likely answer that the story does not give.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Point to the sentence in the passage that says it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Jibu la swali la ufahamu liko kwenye kifungu. Tafuta sentensi inayolisema.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Picks another detail from the story.

example.question: Mvua ilinyesha lini?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child picks a detail from the right place but not the one asked.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Read the question word again: who, when, where, what?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Maneno ya swali (nani, lini, wapi, nini) yanaonyesha jibu la aina gani. Soma kifungu tena.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives a detail for the main message.

example.question: Ujumbe mkuu wa hadithi ni upi?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child takes the most vivid detail.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A detail and a message as options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: What did the story want us to learn?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Ujumbe mkuu ni funzo la hadithi nzima, si jambo moja dogo ndani yake.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Puts the events in the wrong order.

example.question: Matukio manne yamechanganywa. Yalitokea kwa mpangilio gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child goes by the order in the question and not in the story.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: Four events shown out of order.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Find the first event, then the next.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hadithi inasimulia matukio kwa mpangilio. Maneno kama "kisha" na "baadaye" husaidia.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Gives the English word as the meaning, or a word from the mother tongue, instead of a Kiswahili explanation.

example.question: Katika kifungu, "sebule" maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: chumba cha kukaa na kupokea wageni

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child translates in his head and writes what he thought.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: The question "Katika kifungu, "sebule" maana yake ni nini?" with "sitting room" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.help: Ask for the meaning in Kiswahili words; use a picture of the room to talk about it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Eleza maana kwa Kiswahili: sebule ni chumba cha kukaa na wageni.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.error: Calls a text that describes a person or thing a masimulizi.

example.question: Ni insha ya aina gani? "Bibi yangu ni mpole. Ana nywele nyeupe na anapenda kusimulia hadithi."

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.cause: The child sees that it is about a person and thinks of a story.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.help: Does the text tell what happened in order, or what the person is like?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.feedback: Wasifu humwelezea mtu au kitu: sura, tabia na maisha. Masimulizi husimulia matukio kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.error: Calls a text that tells what happened a wasifu.

example.question: Ni insha ya aina gani? "Jumamosi, Achieng alienda sokoni. Mvua ilianza kunyesha, akakimbilia dukani."

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.cause: The child sees a person and thinks it describes her.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.help: Is something happening, one thing after another?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia mambo yaliyotokea kwa mpangilio. Wasifu huelezea jinsi mtu alivyo.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.error: Calls a text that explains how to do something a masimulizi.

example.question: Ni insha ya aina gani? "Ili kupika wali, osha mchele kwanza. Kisha chemsha maji."

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.cause: The child sees steps and reads them as events.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.reveals: Instructions that sound like a story.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.help: Is it telling what happened, or how to do it?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.feedback: Maelezo hueleza jambo au jinsi ya kufanya kitu hatua kwa hatua.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.error: Mixes the parts of an insha (utangulizi, kiini, hitimisho).

example.question: Sehemu ya mwisho ya insha huitwa ___.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.cause: The child knows the three names but not their order.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.reveals: The three parts asked in turn.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.help: Which part comes first, which in the middle, which last?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi mwanzoni, kiini katikati na hitimisho mwishoni.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should describe the person, place or thing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Nyumbani Kwetu"?
example.correct_answer: Nyumba yetu ina paa jekundu na madirisha manne makubwa.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Nyumbani Kwetu"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it looks like, what it is for.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Nyumbani Kwetu"?
example.correct_answer: Nyumba yetu ina paa jekundu na madirisha manne makubwa.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Nyumbani Kwetu"?" with "Nyumba yetu ni nzuri sana." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Uses a describing word that does not agree with its noun (bendera mzuri, miti mrefu).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?
example.wrong_answer: Nyumba yetu ina vyumba vitatu mikubwa.
example.correct_answer: Nyumba yetu ina vyumba vitatu vikubwa.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child uses one form of the adjective (m-) for every noun, as he hears it for people.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?" with "Nyumba yetu ina vyumba vitatu mikubwa." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Find the noun first, then its ngeli, then the prefix of the adjective.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Nyumbani Kwetu", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Nyumba yetu ina paa jekundu na madirisha manne makubwa.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Nyumbani Kwetu", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.error: Picks a verb (a word for an action) for a noun.

example.question: Mama ananunua ___ sokoni.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.cause: The child sees a word that goes with the sentence and does not ask what kind of word it is.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.reveals: A gap that needs a thing, with a verb among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.help: Ask: is it the name of something, or something being done?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.feedback: Nomino ni jina la mtu, mnyama, mahali au kitu. "Anapika" ni kitenzi, kinaonyesha kitendo.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.error: Picks an adjective (a word that describes) for a noun.

example.question: Ni neno lipi ni nomino?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.cause: The child picks the word that tells about the thing, not the thing.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.help: Can you hold it, see it or name it? Then it may be a noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.feedback: Nomino ni jina la kitu chenyewe. "Kubwa" ni kivumishi, kinaeleza kitu kikoje.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.error: Picks a word of time or manner (haraka, jana, sana) for a noun.

example.question: Ni neno lipi ni nomino?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.cause: The child picks a short word that fits the sentence.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.reveals: A noun among words of time and manner.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.feedback: "Haraka" na "jana" ni vielezi: vinaonyesha jinsi au wakati. Nomino hutaja mtu, mnyama, mahali au kitu.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_P.error: Picks a pronoun (yeye, wao, huyu) as the noun in the sentence.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi katika sentensi: "Yeye alimpa mtoto chakula"?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_P.cause: A pronoun stands where a noun stands, so the child takes it for one.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_P.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ipi katika sentensi: "Yeye alimpa mtoto chakula"?" with "Yeye" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_P.help: Ask: does the word name someone or something, or does it point to someone already named?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_P.feedback: Yeye ni kiwakilishi: kinasimama badala ya jina. Nomino ni jina: mtoto, chakula.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_P.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.error: Picks a noun for a verb.

example.question: Juma ___ mpira uwanjani.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.cause: The child takes the word nearest the gap that names a thing.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.reveals: A gap that needs an action, with a noun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.feedback: Kitenzi kinaonyesha kitendo: anacheza. "Uwanja" ni nomino, ni jina la mahali.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.error: Picks an adjective for a verb.

example.question: Mama ___ chakula jikoni.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.cause: The child picks a word that goes with chakula.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.reveals: A gap that needs an action, with a describing word among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.help: Can you do the word? Cooking can be done; "kitamu" cannot.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.feedback: Kitenzi kinaonyesha kitendo. "Kitamu" ni kivumishi, kinaeleza chakula kikoje.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.error: Picks a word of time or manner (sasa, mapema) for a verb.

example.question: Wakulima ___ mahindi shambani.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.cause: The child picks a small word that seems to fit.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.reveals: A gap that needs an action, with a time or manner word.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.feedback: "Mapema" ni kielezi cha wakati. Kitenzi ni neno la kitendo, kama "wanapanda".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.error: Takes the verb-noun with ku- (kusoma ni kuzuri) and the verb in a sentence as different kinds, or calls a verb-noun the verb of the sentence.

example.question: Ni kitenzi kipi katika sentensi: "Kuogelea kunafurahisha"?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.cause: Every word with ku- looks like a verb to the child.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.reveals: The question "Ni kitenzi kipi katika sentensi: "Kuogelea kunafurahisha"?" with "Kuogelea" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.help: Ask what the sentence says is happening; the ku- word here is the thing being talked about.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.feedback: Kuogelea hapa ni jina la jambo; kitenzi ni kunafurahisha.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.error: Picks a noun for an adjective.

example.question: Mtoto ___ anacheza uwanjani.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.cause: The child picks a word for a person.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.reveals: A gap that needs a describing word, with a noun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.help: Ask: does the word tell what kind of child?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.feedback: Kivumishi kinaeleza nomino ikoje, kama "mdogo". "Mwalimu" ni nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.error: Picks a verb for an adjective.

example.question: Nyumba ___ ina bustani.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.cause: The child fills the gap with any word that fits the meaning.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.reveals: A gap that needs a describing word, with a verb among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.help: Does the word tell how the house is, or what it does?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.feedback: Kivumishi kinaeleza nomino ikoje: nyumba nzuri. "Inaonekana" ni kitenzi.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.error: Uses an adjective that does not agree with its noun (watoto mdogo, kiti mkubwa).

example.question: Watoto ___ wanacheza.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.cause: The child keeps the form of the adjective for one thing.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.reveals: Plural and singular nouns in turn, with the same adjective.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.help: Count: one or many? The adjective changes with the noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.feedback: Kivumishi hubadilika kulingana na nomino: mtoto mdogo, watoto wadogo; kiti kikubwa, viti vikubwa.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.error: Puts the describing word before the noun, as in English (mzuri mtoto, kubwa nyumba).

example.question: Ni ipi ni sahihi?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.cause: In English the adjective comes first, and the child carries that order over.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni sahihi?" with "mzuri mtoto" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.help: Say noun first, then the word that describes it; build phrases with two cards that must be in order.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.feedback: Katika Kiswahili, nomino hutangulia kivumishi: mtoto mzuri, nyumba kubwa.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Gives the greeting back as the reply (Hujambo for Sijambo).

example.question: Mtu akikusalimia "Hujambo?", unajibu "___."

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child repeats the word he heard.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: A greeting and its reply as options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Who is asking, and who answers?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Hujambo hujibiwa kwa "Sijambo". Shikamoo hujibiwa kwa "Marahaba".
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses a greeting of the wrong time of day (habari za asubuhi at night).

example.question: Kabla ya kulala usiku unamwambia mama, "___."

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child knows the greeting but not when it is used.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: A morning greeting for an evening situation.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: What time of day is it?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: "Habari za asubuhi" ni ya asubuhi. "Usiku mwema" husemwa usiku kabla ya kulala.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Greets an elder with the greeting for a friend (hujambo for shikamoo).

example.question: Unamsalimia babu yako kwa kusema "___."

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child uses one greeting for everyone.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: An elder and a friend as the people greeted.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Is the person older than you?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Mdogo humsalimia mkubwa kwa "Shikamoo", na mkubwa hujibu "Marahaba". "Hujambo" ni ya rika moja.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses a greeting where a farewell is needed (Hujambo! when leaving), or the reverse.

example.question: Unaondoka nyumbani kwa shangazi jioni. Unasema nini?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: Greeting and farewell words are learnt together on one chart and the child mixes the columns.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unaondoka nyumbani kwa shangazi jioni. Unasema nini?" with "Hujambo shangazi!" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Act out arriving and leaving at a door; the child says the right word at each.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Looks at the first letter only (words that begin alike).

example.question: Kati ya "samaki", "sahani" na "sufuria", neno linalokuja kwanza ni ___.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child stops when the first letters are the same.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: Words that begin with the same letter.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: When the first letters match, look at the second.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Maneno yakianza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Kati ya "ua", "ardhi" na "wali", neno linalokuja kwanza ni ___.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child orders by how short or long the word is.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: A short word that begins with a late letter.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: Go by the letters of the alphabet, not by how long the word is.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Goes from z back to a.

example.question: Kati ya "baba", "mto" na "zeze", neno linalokuja kwanza ni ___.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child reads the alphabet from the end.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: First and last words asked in turn.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Alfabeti huanza na a na kuishia na z. Neno lenye herufi ya mwanzo karibu na a hutangulia.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Does not know what a dictionary is for (takes it for a storybook or a book of pictures).

example.question: Kamusi hutusaidia kupata ___ ya neno.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child has seen a dictionary but not used it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: The use of a dictionary asked directly.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: What do you look for when you meet a word you do not know?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Kamusi ni kitabu chenye maneno na maana zake, yaliyopangwa kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Siku Nilipokula na Wageni"?
example.wrong_answer: Watu wengi hula mara tatu kwa siku.
example.correct_answer: Jana jioni tulikula chakula pamoja na wageni wetu.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Siku Nilipokula na Wageni"?" with "Watu wengi hula mara tatu kwa siku." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Siku Nilipokula na Wageni"?
example.wrong_answer: Jana jioni tunakula chakula pamoja na wageni wetu.
example.correct_answer: Jana jioni tulikula chakula pamoja na wageni wetu.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Siku Nilipokula na Wageni"?" with "Jana jioni tunakula chakula pamoja na wageni wetu." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Siku Nilipokula na Wageni"?
example.wrong_answer: tulishukuru, tulikula, tuliketi mezani, tulinawa mikono
example.correct_answer: tulinawa mikono, tuliketi mezani, tulikula, tulishukuru

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Siku Nilipokula na Wageni"?" with "tulishukuru, tulikula, tuliketi mezani, tulinawa mikono" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Siku Nilipokula na Wageni"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Siku Nilipokula na Wageni"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.error: Repeats the noun instead of using a pronoun.

example.question: Wanjiru ni msichana. ___ anapenda kusoma.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.cause: The child does not see that a pronoun stands in place of the name.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.reveals: A second sentence that needs a pronoun, with the name among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.help: Ask: which word saves us saying the name again?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.feedback: Kiwakilishi husimama mahali pa nomino ili tusirudie jina: "Yeye" badala ya "Wanjiru".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.error: Uses a pronoun for one where there are many, or for many where there is one (yeye for wao).

example.question: Juma na Otieno ni marafiki. ___ wanacheza pamoja.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.cause: The child does not count the people.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.reveals: A pair of people with a one-person pronoun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.help: Count the people. One is "yeye", many are "wao".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.feedback: "Yeye" ni mtu mmoja. "Wao" ni watu wengi. Juma na Otieno ni wawili, kwa hiyo ni "wao".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.error: Swaps the person (mimi, wewe, yeye, sisi, nyinyi, wao).

example.question: Mimi na wewe ni marafiki. ___ tunasoma pamoja.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.cause: The child knows the pronouns but not who is speaking.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.reveals: A sentence about the speaker and the listener.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.help: Does it include me, the speaker?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.feedback: "Sisi" ni mimi na wengine. "Wao" ni watu wengine, bila mimi.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.error: Swaps the near and the far one (huyu for yule, hawa for wale).

example.question: Angalia, ___ ni mwalimu wetu, ameketi karibu nami.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.cause: The child does not take the distance into account.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.reveals: A person who is close and a person who is far, with both words as options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.help: Is the person near you or far from you?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.feedback: "Huyu" na "hawa" hutumika kwa walio karibu. "Yule" na "wale" hutumika kwa walio mbali.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.error: Uses an adjective for an adverb (anaimba nzuri for anaimba vizuri).

example.question: Wanafunzi wanaimba ___ darasani.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.cause: The child uses the describing word of a noun for the way something is done.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.reveals: A gap that tells how something is done, with the adjective among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.help: Does it tell how they sing, or what kind of thing it is?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.feedback: Kielezi kinaonyesha jinsi kitendo kinavyofanyika: wanaimba vizuri. "Nzuri" ni kivumishi cha nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.error: Picks a noun for an adverb.

example.question: Mtoto alikimbia ___ kuelekea nyumbani.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.cause: The child picks a word of the place and not the way.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.reveals: A gap that tells how something is done, with a noun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.help: Does the word tell how he ran?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.feedback: "Haraka" ni kielezi cha jinsi. "Barabara" ni nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.error: Mixes the three kinds of adverb (time, place, manner).

example.question: Kielezi "jana" kinaonyesha ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.cause: The child knows the word is an adverb but not what it tells.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.reveals: Adverbs of time, place and manner asked in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.help: Ask: does it tell when, where or how?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.feedback: Vielezi vya wakati (jana, kesho), mahali (hapa, mbali) na jinsi (polepole, haraka) vinajibu "lini", "wapi" na "vipi".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.error: Takes a place word (nyumbani, shuleni) for a noun, not an adverb of place, in a sentence.

example.question: Neno "shuleni" katika "Tunasoma shuleni" ni nini?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.cause: The child sees the noun shule inside the word and stops there.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.reveals: The question "Neno "shuleni" katika "Tunasoma shuleni" ni nini?" with "nomino" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.help: Ask what question the word answers: wapi? lini? vipi? The -ni ending turns the noun into a place word.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.feedback: Shuleni hujibu swali "wapi?": ni kielezi cha mahali.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Takes a methali for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: A riddle hides an answer. Can you guess it?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Kitendawili huficha jibu na humtaka mtu kukitegua. Methali hutoa funzo.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Takes a nahau for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: Both can be a short phrase.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: Can you give an answer to it?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili kina jibu la kutegua.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Takes an ordinary sentence for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: The child does not see that a riddle hides the thing it describes.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.reveals: A riddle and a plain sentence.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: Does the text name the thing, or hide it?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Does not know the words used when riddling (Kitendawili! Tega!).

example.question: Mtegaji husema "Kitendawili!" Mtegua hujibu "___!"

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: The child has heard a riddle told but not the fixed words.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.reveals: The opening and the giving-up words.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: What does the guesser say to say he is ready?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Mtegaji husema "Kitendawili!" na mtegua hujibu "Tega!". Akishindwa husema "Nipe mji."
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Gives a thing that shares one detail with the riddle but is not the answer.

example.question: "Popote niendapo hunifuata." Jibu ni nini?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: The child picks the first thing that comes to mind.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: Test each answer against every part of the riddle.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Thinks that reading fast is reading well.

example.question: Ni nini kinachoonyesha kusoma kwa ufasaha?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child hears that good readers are quick.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Can the listener follow every word?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Kasi ifaayo si haraka sana wala polepole sana: msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Thinks that reading loud is reading well.

example.question: Sauti ipasavyo wakati wa kusoma ni ipi?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child takes loud for clear.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Is a shout the same as a clear voice?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Sauti ipasavyo inasikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Ignores the koma and the kikomo.

example.question: Ukifika kwenye koma, ufanye nini?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child reads the words and skips the marks.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A mark that asks for a rest.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: What does the mark tell the reader to do?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Alama za uakifishi zinaonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: koma kidogo, kikomo muda mrefu zaidi.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Mama alinunua sare mpya ya shule sokoni."?
example.wrong_answer: Mama ... alinunua ... sare ... mpya ... ya ... shule ... sokoni.
example.correct_answer: Mama alinunua sare mpya ya shule sokoni.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Mama alinunua sare mpya ya shule sokoni."?" with "Mama ... alinunua ... sare ... mpya ... ya ... shule ... sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umevaa koti lako leo?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umevaa koti lako leo?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Lo, viatu vyako vinang'aa sana!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Lo, viatu vyako vinang'aa sana!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (rangi read as langi).

example.question: Neno "rangi" linatamkwa vipi?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Neno "rangi" linatamkwa vipi?" with "langi" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Tamka "rangi" kama lilivyoandikwa; "langi" ni neno jingine au si neno.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Thinks gestures and looking up at the listeners have nothing to do with reading well.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kipengele cha kusoma kwa ufasaha?
example.wrong_answer: kuangalia kitabu tu bila kuwaangalia wasikilizaji
example.correct_answer: kuambatanisha ishara na kuwaangalia wasikilizaji mara kwa mara

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: Reading has only been practised silently or with eyes on the page.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kipengele cha kusoma kwa ufasaha?" with "kuangalia kitabu tu bila kuwaangalia wasikilizaji" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Watch a good reader: list what the body does as well as the voice.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Msomaji mzuri huwaangalia wasikilizaji na kutumia ishara zifaazo.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Mixes the parts of a computer (kibodi, kipanya, skrini).

example.question: Tunatumia ___ kupigia herufi na nambari.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.cause: The child knows the names but not what each is.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.reveals: Parts asked by what they are used for.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.help: What do you hold, press or look at?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Kibodi ina vitufe vya herufi na nambari. Kipanya husogeza kielekezi. Skrini huonyesha. Kichapishi huchapisha.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Gives the use of another part.

example.question: Skrini hufanya nini?

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.cause: The child has the right word for the wrong job.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.reveals: The use of the part asked in turn.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.help: What do you do with this part?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Kila sehemu ya tarakilishi ina kazi yake: skrini huonyesha, kichapishi huchapisha kwenye karatasi.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.error: Starts a sentence or a name with a small letter.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.cause: The child does not see the first letter.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.help: What do we write first in a sentence?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, na majina ya pekee pia: Wanjiru, Nairobi.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.error: Ends a question with a kikomo (.) instead of a kiulizi (?).

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.cause: The child ends every sentence with a full stop.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.reveals: The same question with different marks.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Sentensi ya swali huisha kwa kiulizi (?). Sentensi ya kawaida huisha kwa kikomo (.).
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.error: Leaves out the koma in a list, or puts it in the wrong place.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.cause: The child does not pause the sentence where the list items end.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.reveals: A list with and without koma.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.help: Where would you rest your voice?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Koma hutenganisha vitu katika orodha: maembe, machungwa na ndizi.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia kama furaha au mshangao: Hongera! Kiulizi (?) huuliza.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.error: Leaves out the mark at the end of the sentence.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.cause: The child stops writing at the last word.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.reveals: The same sentence with and without its closing mark.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Kila sentensi huisha kwa alama: kikomo (.), kiulizi (?) au alama ya hisi (!).
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.error: Switches the computer off by pulling the plug or pressing the power button at once, losing the work.

example.question: Umemaliza kazi. Unazimaje tarakilishi?
example.correct_answer: hifadhi kazi, funga programu, kisha zima kupitia menyu

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.help: Practise the shut-down steps with step cards, then on a real machine.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.feedback: Hifadhi kazi kwanza, kisha zima tarakilishi kupitia menyu.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.error: Closes the document without saving, or saves with no name (Document1) where he cannot find it.

example.question: Ni jina lipi bora la faili ya insha yako ya mavazi?

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.cause: The child does not know that the work disappears or that the name is how he finds it again.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.reveals: The question "Ni jina lipi bora la faili ya insha yako ya mavazi?" with "Document1" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.help: Save, close, then reopen the file by its name in front of the class.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.feedback: Hifadhi kazi kwa jina linaloeleza kilicho ndani.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.error: Types words without spaces, or presses the space bar many times instead of using Enter for a new line.

example.question: Ni kitufe kipi huanzisha mstari mpya?

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.cause: The child has not met the job of each big key.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.reveals: The question "Ni kitufe kipi huanzisha mstari mpya?" with "kitufe cha nafasi mara nyingi" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.help: Label the space bar, Enter, Shift and Backspace; type one line, then a new one.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.feedback: Enter huanzisha mstari mpya; nafasi hutenganisha maneno.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.error: Leaves caps lock on and types the whole text in capitals, or never makes a capital at the start of a sentence.

example.question: Unataka herufi kubwa moja tu mwanzoni mwa sentensi. Unafanya nini?
example.wrong_answer: washa Caps Lock na uandike sentensi yote

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.cause: The caps lock light is the only way of making capitals the child has seen.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.reveals: The question "Unataka herufi kubwa moja tu mwanzoni mwa sentensi. Unafanya nini?" with "washa Caps Lock na uandike sentensi yote" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.help: Type one sentence with Shift for the first letter; compare with all capitals.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.feedback: Tumia Shift kwa herufi kubwa moja; Caps Lock hufanya herufi zote kuwa kubwa.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Thinks the screen is the computer and the box (kitengo kikuu) only holds the cables.

example.question: Sehemu ipi ya tarakilishi hufanya kazi ya kufikiri na kuhifadhi?

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.cause: The screen is where everything is seen, so the child takes it for the computer.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.reveals: The question "Sehemu ipi ya tarakilishi hufanya kazi ya kufikiri na kuhifadhi?" with "skrini" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.help: Switch the screen off while the computer runs; the work is still there.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Kitengo kikuu ndicho hufanya kazi; skrini huonyesha tu.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Knows the parts only by their English names (mouse, keyboard) and not kipanya and kibodi.

example.question: Kipanya ni sehemu ipi?

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.reveals: The question "Kipanya ni sehemu ipi?" with "keyboard" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.help: Label the parts in Kiswahili and use only those in class.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili: kibodi, kipanya, skrini, kitengo kikuu.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.error: Picks a joining word of another meaning (kwa sababu for lakini, ili for au).

example.question: Alitaka kuogelea, ___ ziwa lilikuwa na mawimbi makali.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.cause: The child picks a joining word without asking how the two parts are related.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.reveals: Two parts that are in contrast, with the reason word among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.help: Do the two parts agree, or does the second go against the first?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.feedback: Kila kiunganishi kina kazi: "lakini" kinaonyesha kinyume, "kwa sababu" kinatoa sababu, "ili" kinaonyesha kusudi, "na" kinaongeza.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.error: Picks a noun or a verb for a joining word.

example.question: Juma ___ Otieno ni marafiki.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.cause: The child chooses a word that is already in the sentence.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.reveals: A gap between two names, with a noun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.help: Which word joins the two names?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.feedback: Kiunganishi huunganisha maneno au sentensi, kama "na", "lakini" na "kwa sababu". Si nomino wala kitenzi.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.error: Uses na for every join, even where the meaning is "but" or "because" (Nilienda na sikumpata).

example.question: Jaza: Nilienda kwake ___ sikumpata.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.cause: Na is the first joining word learnt and covers "and" for everything.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.reveals: The question "Jaza: Nilienda kwake ___ sikumpata." with "na" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.help: Ask whether the second part agrees with the first or goes against it; against means lakini.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.feedback: Sehemu ya pili inapingana na ya kwanza, kwa hiyo tumia lakini.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.error: Swaps the reason and the result (kwa hiyo for kwa sababu).

example.question: Jaza: Hakuja shuleni ___ alikuwa mgonjwa.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.reveals: The question "Jaza: Hakuja shuleni ___ alikuwa mgonjwa." with "kwa hiyo" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.help: Draw an arrow from cause to effect; kwa sababu points back to the cause, kwa hiyo forward to the result.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.feedback: Kuwa mgonjwa ni sababu, kwa hiyo tumia kwa sababu.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.error: Picks a noun, a verb or an adjective as the relating word.

example.question: Ni kihusishi kipi katika sentensi: "Kitabu kiko juu ya meza."

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.cause: The child picks the word that is easiest to see.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.reveals: A sentence with a place word, with the nouns as options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.help: Which words tell where the book is in relation to the table?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.feedback: Kihusishi hueleza uhusiano wa nomino na neno lingine, kama "juu ya", "chini ya" na "ndani ya". "Meza" ni nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.error: Uses the wrong -a of agreement for the noun (kitabu wa mwalimu, nyumba cha bibi).

example.question: Kitabu ___ mwalimu kiko mezani.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.cause: The child keeps one form for every noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.reveals: Nouns of different classes before the same word.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.help: Which class is the noun in? Kitabu is KI-VI, so cha.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.feedback: Kihusishi cha "a" hubadilika kulingana na ngeli: kitabu cha, vitabu vya, mlango wa, milango ya, jina la, majina ya, nyumba ya.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.error: Swaps place words that mean the opposite (juu ya for chini ya, ndani ya for nje ya).

example.question: Samaki wanaishi ___ ya maji, si nje yake.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.cause: The child knows the words but not which way each points.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.reveals: A sentence that says where, with the opposite word among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.help: Read the clue in the sentence: inside or outside?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.feedback: "Ndani ya" na "nje ya" ni vinyume. "Juu ya" na "chini ya" ni vinyume pia.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.error: Uses na where the tool is meant (aliandika na kalamu) or kwa where the companion is meant (alienda kwa mama).

example.question: Jaza: Aliandika barua ___ kalamu.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.cause: English "with" covers both the tool and the companion.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.reveals: The question "Jaza: Aliandika barua ___ kalamu." with "na" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.help: Ask: is it a tool (kwa) or a person going along (na)?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.feedback: Chombo cha kufanyia kazi huchukua kwa: kwa kalamu. Mtu aliyeandamana huchukua na: na mama.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.error: Picks an exclamation of another feeling (hongera for pole).

example.question: Mwenzako ameanguka na kuumia. Utasema ___!

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.cause: The child knows the words but does not ask what the feeling is.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.reveals: A sad situation, with a happy word among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.help: What does the other person feel? What would you say?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.feedback: Kihisishi huonyesha hisia: "Pole!" kwa huzuni, "Hongera!" kwa mafanikio, "Samahani!" ukikosea, "Karibu!" kwa mgeni.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.error: Picks a noun or a verb for an exclamation.

example.question: Hongera! Juma ameshinda mbio za shule. Ni kihisishi kipi?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.cause: The child does not know the exclamation has the mark ! and shows a feeling.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.reveals: A sentence that begins with an exclamation, with the other words as options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.help: Which word shows a feeling and carries the mark !?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.feedback: Kihisishi kinaonyesha hisia na huandikwa pamoja na alama ya hisi (!). "Juma" ni nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.error: Writes an exclamation with a kikomo or no mark, not the alama ya hisi (!).

example.question: Ni ipi imeandikwa ipasavyo?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.cause: The child knows the word but not that its feeling is shown with a mark.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.reveals: The question "Ni ipi imeandikwa ipasavyo?" with "Lo. Umependeza." among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.help: Read the line with and without feeling; the ! asks for the feeling.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.feedback: Kihisishi hufuatwa na alama ya hisi: Lo!
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.error: Uses an English exclamation (Wow!, Sorry!, Eish!) in a Kiswahili sentence.

example.question: Ni kihisishi kipi cha Kiswahili kinaonyesha mshangao?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.cause: The child hears English and Sheng exclamations every day.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.reveals: The question "Ni kihisishi kipi cha Kiswahili kinaonyesha mshangao?" with "Wow!" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.help: Make a feelings chart in Kiswahili: mshangao (Lo! Ala!), huzuni (Pole! Ole!), furaha (Hongera!).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili tunasema Lo! au Ala! kwa mshangao.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti"?" with "Miti ni mizuri." among the options.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.wrong_answer: mwagilia maji, funika kwa udongo, weka mche, chimba shimo
example.correct_answer: chimba shimo, weka mche, funika kwa udongo, mwagilia maji

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti"?" with "mwagilia maji, funika kwa udongo, weka mche, chimba shimo" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
