KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.error: Uses vi- with one noun of KI-VI.

example.question: Kiti kimoja ___meanguka.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.cause: The child has fixed vi- as the prefix of KI-VI.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.feedback: Nomino za KI-VI hutumia ki- kwa umoja: kiti kimeanguka. Hutumia vi- kwa wingi: viti vimeanguka.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.error: Uses ki- with many nouns of KI-VI.

example.question: Viti viwili ___meanguka.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.cause: The child does not see that the noun is plural.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.reveals: Plural nouns that begin with vi-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.help: Vi- tells you it is many.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.feedback: Wingi wa kiti ni viti, na kiambishi ni vi-: viti vimeanguka.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.error: Makes the plural noun by adding a prefix and keeping ki- (vikitabu, vikiatu).

example.question: Kitabu kimoja, ___ viwili.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.cause: The child adds vi- in front and does not drop ki-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.reveals: Nouns of KI-VI in the plural.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.help: ki- is replaced by vi-, not added to.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.feedback: Katika wingi, ki- hubadilika kuwa vi-: kitabu-vitabu, kiatu-viatu, kikombe-vikombe.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.error: Puts a noun of another class in KI-VI.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya KI-VI?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.cause: The child sees a k in the word and thinks of ki-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.reveals: Nouns of other classes with a k in them.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.help: Does the noun begin with ki-, and is its plural vi-?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.feedback: Kikombe-vikombe ni KI-VI. Jiwe-mawe ni LI-YA.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.error: Gives a noun of KI-VI the prefix of another class (limeanguka for kimeanguka).

example.question: Kiti kimoja ___meanguka.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.cause: The child does not tell which class the noun belongs to.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.help: The noun begins with ki- or vi-. Its prefixes are ki- and vi-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.feedback: Nomino za KI-VI hutumia ki- kwa umoja na vi- kwa wingi, si li-, ya-, u- wala i-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.error: Uses ya- with jua or giza because of the ma- plural of LI-YA.

example.question: Jua ___metoka asubuhi.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.cause: The child carries the LI-YA rule over to nouns that do not change.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.reveals: The nouns jua and giza in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.help: The noun does not change. What does the sentence tell you?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.feedback: Jua na giza ni nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI: kiambishi ni li-: jua limetoka, giza limeingia.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.error: Gives jua or giza the prefix of another class (u- or i-).

example.question: Giza ___meingia haraka.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.cause: The child hears jua or giza as a thing of the U-I class.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.reveals: Jua and giza with several prefixes.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.help: Which class does the design put jua and giza in?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.feedback: Jua na giza ni LI-LI: vinatumia li-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.error: Puts a noun of another class in LI-LI.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya LI-LI?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.cause: The child has few examples of LI-LI to compare.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.reveals: Jua or giza among nouns of other classes.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.help: Which of them is in the class the design names?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.feedback: Kati ya nomino hizi, jua na giza ndizo za LI-LI. Mti uko U-I.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.error: Makes a plural for a noun of LI-LI (majua, magiza).

example.question: Wingi wa "jua" katika "Jua limewaka" ni upi?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.cause: Most li- nouns the child knows (jiwe/mawe) have a ma- plural.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "jua" katika "Jua limewaka" ni upi?" with "majua" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.help: Show that there is only one sun: the noun and its prefix stay li- in both.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.feedback: Nomino za LI-LI hazibadiliki katika wingi: jua limewaka.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Kisawe cha "furaha" ni ___.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_O.cause: The child knows the topic but not which way it points.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_O.feedback: Kisawe ni neno lenye maana sawa. Kinyume cha furaha ni huzuni, si kisawe.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_O.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_L.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.

example.question: Kisawe cha "haraka" ni ___.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_L.cause: The child goes by the first letters.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_L.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_L.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_L.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_R.error: Picks a related word that is not the same in meaning.

example.question: Kisawe cha "tajiri" ni ___.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_R.cause: The child picks a word that goes with the idea.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_R.reveals: A related word as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_R.help: Can you put it in place of the word, with the same meaning?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_R.feedback: Kisawe kinaweza kuchukua mahali pa neno bila kubadilisha maana. Tajiri na mkwasi wana maana sawa.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_R.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_W.error: Gives a synonym of another kind of word (a verb for a noun: nyumba - kuishi).

example.question: Kisawe cha "nyumba" ni kipi?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_W.cause: The child links the words by an idea (a house is where you live), not by meaning.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_W.reveals: The question "Kisawe cha "nyumba" ni kipi?" with "kuishi" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_W.help: Check the synonym can stand in the same sentence in place of the word.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_W.feedback: Kisawe kinaweza kuchukua nafasi ya neno katika sentensi ileile: nyumba / makazi.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M4_VIS_W.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Takes a line of a story for a line of a play (or the reverse).

example.question: Ni kipi kati ya hivi kinatoka kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child does not see the name and the colon.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A play line and a story line side by side.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Does the line begin with a name and a colon?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Takes the words in brackets for words that are said.

example.question: Ni maelekezo ya jukwaani yapi?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child reads everything on the page as speech.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A stage direction among spoken lines.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: What does the actor do, and what does he say?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Maelekezo ya jukwaani yako kwenye mabano. Yanamwonyesha muigizaji afanye nini, si aseme nini.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Names the wrong speaker of a line.

example.question: Nani alisema, "Nipe kilo mbili za unga"?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child goes by the name closest to the line.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A line next to the name of another speaker.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: The name before the colon is the speaker.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mhusika anayesema mstari huo.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Answers from what the child knows, not from the play.

example.question: Atieno alinunua nini dukani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child gives a likely answer and does not look in the play.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A likely answer that the play does not give.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Point to the line in the play that says it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Jibu la swali la igizo liko ndani ya igizo. Tafuta mstari unaolisema.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?
example.wrong_answer: Twiga ni mnyama mrefu kuliko wanyama wote.
example.correct_answer: Tuliona twiga wakila majani ya mti mrefu.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?" with "Twiga ni mnyama mrefu kuliko wanyama wote." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?
example.wrong_answer: Tunaona twiga wakila majani ya mti mrefu.
example.correct_answer: Tuliona twiga wakila majani ya mti mrefu.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?" with "Tunaona twiga wakila majani ya mti mrefu." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?
example.wrong_answer: tulirudi jioni, tuliona wanyama, tulifika mbugani, tuliondoka shuleni
example.correct_answer: tuliondoka shuleni, tulifika mbugani, tuliona wanyama, tulirudi jioni

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?" with "tulirudi jioni, tuliona wanyama, tulifika mbugani, tuliondoka shuleni" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Leaves the verb in its base form where someone is helped (anaandika for anamwandikia).

example.question: Mwalimu ___ wanafunzi barua.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The child does not see that the verb has to show for whom.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: A sentence with a person who benefits.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Is it done for someone? Then the verb ends in -ia or -ea.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Kauli ya kutendea huonyesha kitendo kinafanyiwa mtu: anawaandikia, anampikia, anamsomea.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Leaves the verb active where the thing is done to (barua imeandika na mwalimu).

example.question: Barua ___ na mwalimu.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The child does not see that the thing, not the person, is the subject.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: A sentence that begins with the thing that was done.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Does the thing do it, or is it done to the thing? Then -wa.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Kauli ya kutendwa huonyesha kitu kimefanyiwa kitendo: barua imeandikwa, chai imepikwa.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Mixes -ia (for someone) and -wa (done to the thing).

example.question: Hadithi ___ na watoto wote.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The endings look alike and the child does not ask what the verb says.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: Sentences that need -wa or -ia in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Ask: for someone, or done to the thing?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Kutendea (-ia, -ea) ni "kwa ajili ya mtu". Kutendwa (-wa) ni "kinatendwa na mtu".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Uses na wrongly or leaves out "na" before the doer in the passive (Barua imeandikwa mwalimu).

example.question: Jaza: Barua imeandikwa ___ mwalimu.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: In English the doer follows "by", which the child links to kwa.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: The question "Jaza: Barua imeandikwa ___ mwalimu." with "kwa" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: The doer of a -wa verb is introduced with na: imeandikwa na mwalimu.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Mtendaji wa kitenzi chenye -wa hutajwa kwa "na".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Takes a formal setting for an informal one.

example.question: Ni mazungumzo yapi si rasmi?
example.wrong_answer: hotuba ya mwalimu mkuu kwenye gwaride

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child does not ask who is talking to whom.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: A speech or an interview among settings with a friend.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: Who is speaking to whom, and where?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi ni ya marafiki, nyumbani au wakati wa kucheza. Hotuba na mahojiano ni rasmi.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Uses words of the wrong kind of setting (a speech greeting to a friend at play).

example.question: Unamsalimia rafiki yako uwanjani. Utasema ___.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child has one way of speaking for every place.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: A formal greeting for a friend.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: Would you say it to a friend at play?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Kwa rafiki tunatumia lugha ya kawaida, kama "Mambo vipi?". Hotuba hutumia lugha rasmi.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Uses Sheng or street words to an elder at home (Mambo vipi, mzee?).

example.question: Unamsalimu babu yako nyumbani. Unasema?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The informal talk of friends is the informal talk the child knows; he does not see that home with elders needs respect even when it is not official.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: The question "Unamsalimu babu yako nyumbani. Unasema?" with "Mambo vipi, mzee?" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: Sort sentences into three settings: with friends, with family elders, in official places.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Hata nyumbani, mzee husalimiwa kwa heshima: Shikamoo babu.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Talks over others and does not wait for a turn in an informal chat.

example.question: Wenzako wanazungumza kuhusu mchezo. Unataka kusema jambo. Ufanye nini?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child thinks informal means no rules.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: The question "Wenzako wanazungumza kuhusu mchezo. Unataka kusema jambo. Ufanye nini?" with "zungumza kwa sauti juu yao" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: Pass a talking object in a small group; only the holder speaks.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Hata mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi yana adabu: subiri zamu yako.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu afya bora. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu afya bora. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Usafi, chakula bora na mazoezi hutupa afya njema.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" ni upi?" with "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu afya bora?
example.correct_answer: Usafi, chakula bora na mazoezi hutupa afya njema.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu afya bora?" with "Baraka alikunywa maji glasi nane." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (lishe).

example.question: Katika matini: "Mama alisema lishe bora ina mboga, matunda na nafaka." Neno "lishe" lina maana gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Mama alisema lishe bora ina mboga, matunda na nafaka." Neno "lishe" lina maana gani?" with "kulisha mifugo" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "lishe" hapa ni chakula anachokula mtu.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, lowesha mikono kwa maji safi yanayotiririka.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, lowesha mikono kwa maji safi yanayotiririka.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?" with "Usafi ni muhimu." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?
example.wrong_answer: suuza na kukausha, sugua kwa sekunde ishirini, paka sabuni, lowesha mikono
example.correct_answer: lowesha mikono, paka sabuni, sugua kwa sekunde ishirini, suuza na kukausha

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?" with "suuza na kukausha, sugua kwa sekunde ishirini, paka sabuni, lowesha mikono" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, lowesha mikono kwa maji safi yanayotiririka.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.error: Picks a related word, not the opposite (usiku-jioni, rafiki-ndugu).

example.question: Kinyume cha "usiku" ni ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.cause: The child picks a word of the same family of ideas.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.reveals: A related word as an option.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.help: Is it the opposite, or only near it?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.feedback: Kinyume ni neno lenye maana kinyume kabisa: usiku-mchana. "Jioni" iko karibu na usiku lakini si kinyume.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.error: Picks a word of the same meaning (furaha-raha).

example.question: Kinyume cha "furaha" ni ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.cause: The child mixes the opposite with the synonym.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.feedback: "Raha" ina maana sawa na furaha. Kinyume cha furaha ni huzuni.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.error: Gives the other word of a pair in the wrong place (mgeni-rafiki for mgeni-mwenyeji).

example.question: Kinyume cha "mgeni" ni ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.cause: The child takes a word that goes with the idea.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.reveals: A word that goes with the noun but is not its opposite.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.help: Who is the visitor and who receives him?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.feedback: Mgeni ni anayetembelea, na mwenyeji ni anayepokea. Ni vinyume.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.error: Makes the opposite by adding si or "si-" to the noun (si-rafiki, si urefu).

example.question: Kinyume cha "rafiki" ni kipi?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.cause: Making verbs negative with si- is known; the child uses it for nouns too.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "rafiki" ni kipi?" with "sirafiki" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.help: A noun's opposite is another noun; list pairs: rafiki/adui, mchana/usiku, mwanzo/mwisho.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.feedback: Kinyume cha nomino ni nomino nyingine: rafiki, adui.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.error: Gives the wrong animal or thing in the simile (mrefu kama sungura).

example.question: Mtu mrefu sana ni mrefu kama ___.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.cause: The child knows the idea but not the usual comparison.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.reveals: A simile with plausible animals as options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.help: Which animal do we say is tall?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.feedback: Tashbihi hutumia ulinganisho wa kawaida: mrefu kama twiga, mnene kama kiboko, mkubwa kama ndovu.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.error: Leaves out kama, and says "Yeye ni twiga" as a simile.

example.question: Ni tashbihi ipi?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.cause: The child mixes a simile with a metaphor.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.reveals: A simile and a metaphor as options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.help: A simile has the word kama.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia kama: mrefu kama twiga. "Yeye ni twiga" ni sitiari.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.error: Takes the simile word for word (the person is really a giraffe).

example.question: "Baba ni mrefu kama twiga" maana yake nini?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.cause: The child does not read the comparison as a way to describe.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.reveals: A meaning question for a simile.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.help: What is the animal used to show?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.feedback: Tashbihi inaelezea kwa kulinganisha. "Mrefu kama twiga" ina maana mtu ni mrefu sana.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.error: Joins the right animal to the wrong quality (mfupi kama twiga).

example.question: Kamilisha tashbihi: mrefu kama ___

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.cause: The child knows the animals of similes but not which quality each stands for.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.reveals: The question "Kamilisha tashbihi: mrefu kama ___" with "nyoka" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.help: Make a chart: twiga - urefu, nyoka - wembamba?, tembo - unene; test each simile against the chart.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.feedback: Twiga ni mrefu, kwa hiyo tunasema mrefu kama twiga.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.error: Mixes up a folder and a file: looks for the passage on the screen without opening the folder it is in.

example.question: Kifungu "Usalama wetu" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?
example.wrong_answer: bonyeza "Usalama wetu" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo
example.correct_answer: fungua folda "Kiswahili", kisha bonyeza mara mbili faili "Usalama wetu"

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.cause: The child has only used apps on a phone, where there are no folders.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.reveals: The question "Kifungu "Usalama wetu" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?" with "bonyeza "Usalama wetu" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.help: Show a real folder (a box file) holding papers; then the same on the screen.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.feedback: Faili huhifadhiwa ndani ya folda; fungua folda kwanza, kisha faili.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.error: Types a whole long question, with spelling mistakes, into the search box.

example.question: Unatafuta habari kuhusu kukabiliana na uhalifu. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?
example.wrong_answer: naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu kukabiliana na uhalifu tafadhali

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.cause: The child talks to the search box as to a person.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.reveals: The question "Unatafuta habari kuhusu kukabiliana na uhalifu. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?" with "naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu kukabiliana na uhalifu tafadhali" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.help: Underline the two or three words that carry the meaning; search with those; compare the results.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.feedback: Andika maneno mawili au matatu muhimu tu, na uyaandike kwa tahajia sahihi.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.error: Clicks a pop-up or an advert that says he has won a prize.

example.question: Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usibonyeze; funga ujumbe na umwambie mwalimu au mzazi

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.cause: Offers of prizes are exciting and the child does not know they are traps.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.reveals: The question "Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?" with "bonyeza ili kupokea simu" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.help: Show two screenshots, one real page and one trap; the child finds three signs of the trap.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.feedback: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni mtego; usiubonyeze.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.error: Uses any site that comes up and gives his name, school or phone number when a site asks.

example.question: Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usijaze; tumia tovuti salama aliyokupa mwalimu

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.cause: The child wants the story and does not see personal details as worth protecting.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.reveals: The question "Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?" with "jaza ili usome hadithi" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.help: List the details that are private; practise saying no to a form.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.feedback: Usimpe mtu yeyote mtandaoni jina lako kamili, shule yako wala nambari ya simu.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.error: Puts the steps of finding and reading a passage in the wrong order (reads before searching, or searches before switching on).

example.question: Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.cause: The child has watched an adult do the steps quickly and remembers the parts, not the order.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?" with "andika maneno ya kutafutia" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.help: Step cards: the child orders them, then does them on a real device.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.feedback: Washa kifaa, fungua kivinjari, andika maneno muhimu, chagua tovuti salama, soma.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KIDIJITALI.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?
example.wrong_answer: Wizi ni kosa kubwa katika jamii.
example.correct_answer: Mwizi alinyakua mkoba wa mama mmoja akakimbia.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?" with "Wizi ni kosa kubwa katika jamii." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?
example.wrong_answer: Mwizi ananyakua mkoba wa mama mmoja anakimbia.
example.correct_answer: Mwizi alinyakua mkoba wa mama mmoja akakimbia.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?" with "Mwizi ananyakua mkoba wa mama mmoja anakimbia." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?
example.wrong_answer: mama alirudishiwa mkoba, polisi walimkamata, watu walipiga kelele, mwizi alinyakua mkoba
example.correct_answer: mwizi alinyakua mkoba, watu walipiga kelele, polisi walimkamata, mama alirudishiwa mkoba

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?" with "mama alirudishiwa mkoba, polisi walimkamata, watu walipiga kelele, mwizi alinyakua mkoba" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.error: Uses -na- for every time, whatever the time word.

example.question: Jana, Juma a___soma kitabu.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.cause: The child has fixed -na- as the way to make a verb.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.help: Read the time word first: jana, now, or kesho?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.feedback: Wakati uliopita unatumia -li-: jana alisoma. Uliopo -na-: sasa anasoma. Ujao -ta-: kesho atasoma.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Kesho, Wanjiru a___soma kitabu.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.cause: The child knows the markers but not which time each is for.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.reveals: Past and future time words in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.help: Has it happened, or will it happen?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.feedback: -li- ni kwa yaliyotokea. -ta- ni kwa yatakayotokea.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.error: Keeps the tense right and changes the person prefix (wanasoma for tunasoma).

example.question: Chagua kitenzi: Jana sisi ___ kwa basi.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.cause: The child looks at the tense and not at the person.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.reveals: The same verb with different persons.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.help: Who is it? Sisi is tu-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.feedback: Kitenzi kinahitaji nafsi na wakati: sisi tulisafiri, wao walisafiri, mimi nilisafiri.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.error: Ignores the time word in the sentence (jana, kesho, sasa) and keeps the tense of the sentence before.

example.question: Jaza: Kesho Juma ___ (enda) Nairobi.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.cause: The child copies the tense of the last verb he wrote.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kesho Juma ___ (enda) Nairobi." with "alienda" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.help: Underline the time word first; it decides the marker: jana -li-, sasa -na-, kesho -ta-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Gives a detail of the narration as its message.

example.question: Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu mama aliyeuza mboga sokoni na kuweka akiba. Ujumbe wake ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukiweka akiba kidogo kidogo, tunaweza kutimiza mahitaji yetu.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The detail was vivid; the child has not asked what the whole narration teaches.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu mama aliyeuza mboga sokoni na kuweka akiba. Ujumbe wake ni upi?" with "Mama aliuza sukumawiki sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: After listening, ask: what did the speaker want us to learn? Then: what is one thing that happened?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo la masimulizi yote; jambo moja ni maelezo tu.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Retells the events in a mixed order, starting with the most exciting part.

example.question: Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The child jumps to the part that impressed him most.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?" with "sehemu ya kusisimua zaidi" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: Retell with three fingers: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.feedback: Simulia kwa mpangilio: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Uses gestures or a face that do not match the words (smiles while telling a sad part, stands still for an action).

example.question: Unasimulia: "Tulifurahi sana tulipopata faida!" Ishara ipi inafaa?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The child is nervous and does not link the body to the words.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Unasimulia: "Tulifurahi sana tulipopata faida!" Ishara ipi inafaa?" with "kukunja uso na kuinamisha kichwa" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: Mirror game in pairs: one says a line, the other shows the feeling; swap.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.feedback: Ishara na sura yako ziendane na unachosema.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Mixes English or Sheng into the telling (Then tukaenda..., ilikuwa poa sana).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?
example.wrong_answer: Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana.
example.correct_answer: Kisha tukaenda nyumbani; ilikuwa siku nzuri sana.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The child narrates as he talks with friends.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?" with "Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: Record a telling; play it back; the child finds the non-Kiswahili words and replaces them.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.feedback: Simulia kwa Kiswahili sanifu: kisha, nyumbani, nzuri.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Tells a story that is not on the topic given (mapato (income)).

example.question: Mada ni mapato (income). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?
example.correct_answer: Siku mama aliyeuza mboga sokoni na kuweka akiba

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The child tells the story he knows best, whatever the topic.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Mada ni mapato (income). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?" with "Siku nilipotazama mechi ya mpira" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: Write the topic on the board; before telling, the child says in one sentence how his story fits it.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Baba aliuza mahindi na kuweka pesa benki."?
example.wrong_answer: Baba ... aliuza ... mahindi ... na ... kuweka ... pesa ... benki.
example.correct_answer: Baba aliuza mahindi na kuweka pesa benki.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Baba aliuza mahindi na kuweka pesa benki."?" with "Baba ... aliuza ... mahindi ... na ... kuweka ... pesa ... benki." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umeweka akiba yako wapi?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umeweka akiba yako wapi?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Hongera, umepata faida kubwa!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Hongera, umepata faida kubwa!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (biashara read as biashala).

example.question: Neno "biashara" linatamkwa vipi?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Neno "biashara" linatamkwa vipi?" with "biashala" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Tamka "biashara" kama lilivyoandikwa; "biashala" ni neno jingine au si neno.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.error: Writes to a friend in the stiff words of an official letter (Mheshimiwa, Kuhusu:, Wako mtiifu).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.cause: The child has seen official letters at school and thinks every letter is written that way.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Mheshimiwa Bwana," among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.help: Put a friendly and an official letter side by side; the child highlights the words that differ.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia lugha ya kirafiki: Mpendwa rafiki, Wako akupendaye.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.error: Starts with the news straight after the greeting, with no asking after the friend (maulizo ya hali).

example.question: Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: Hujambo? Natumai u buheri wa afya.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.cause: The child goes to what he wants to say, as in a text message.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.reveals: The question "Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "Nataka kukueleza kuhusu safari yetu." among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.help: Order the parts on cards: anwani, tarehe, salamu, maulizo ya hali, ujumbe, hitimisho, jina.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.feedback: Baada ya salamu, uliza hali ya rafiki yako kabla ya kueleza ujumbe.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.error: Leaves out the date or writes it in the middle of the letter.

example.question: Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, upande wa kulia juu

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.cause: The date is not part of what the child wants to say, so he forgets it.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.reveals: The question "Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "mwishoni, baada ya jina" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.help: Label a model letter; the child places a date card on a blank layout.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.feedback: Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.error: Ends with "Wako mtiifu" and a full name and title, as in an official letter.

example.question: Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.cause: Again the official model is the only one the child has copied.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.reveals: The question "Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Wako mtiifu, Bw. Juma Hamisi" among the options.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.help: Collect three friendly closings and keep them in the exercise book.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T11_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.KUA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Only adds ha- or si- and keeps the tense marker (hanasoma, sinasoma).

example.question: Kanusha: "Mimi ninasoma."

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child does not know that the marker changes in the negative.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A negative made by only adding ha- or si-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: In the present negative, -na- goes and the verb ends in -i.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Kukanusha wakati uliopo: -na- huondolewa na kitenzi huishia -i: nasoma-sisomi, anasoma-hasomi.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Keeps -li- or -ta- after ha- (halipika, hatapika for hakupika).

example.question: Kanusha: "Wanjiru alipika."

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child puts ha- in front and leaves the rest.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A past verb with ha- put in front.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Wakati uliopita ukikanushwa, -li- hubadilika kuwa -ku-: alipika-hakupika.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Gives the negative of another time (hasomi for hakusoma).

example.question: Kanusha: "Wanafunzi wanaimba."

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child negates the verb but does not keep the time.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: Negatives of the three times side by side.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: Which time was the first sentence in?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Ukanushaji huhifadhi wakati: uliopita hawakuimba, uliopo hawaimbi, ujao hawataimba.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Takes a positive verb for a negative one.

example.question: Ni neno lipi limekanushwa?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child does not look for the ha-, si-, hu- or ku-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A negative and a positive verb together.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: Which verb says that it did not, does not or will not happen?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Neno lililokanushwa linaonyesha kwamba kitendo hakifanyiki: hasomi, hakusoma, hatasoma.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.error: Gives the small form (ki-) for the big form (kijiti for jiti).

example.question: Mti mkubwa sana huitwa ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.cause: The child mixes ji- (big) and ki- (small).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.help: Big is ji-. Small is ki-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.feedback: Ukubwa wa nomino hutumia ji-: jiti, jito, jiji. Udogo hutumia ki-: kijiti, kijito, kijiji.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.error: Keeps the noun as it is (mti mkubwa for jiti).

example.question: Mji mkubwa sana huitwa ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.cause: The child uses the adjective mkubwa and does not change the noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.reveals: The plain noun as an option.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.help: Big form: the noun itself changes.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.feedback: Kuonyesha ukubwa, nomino yenyewe hubadilika: mji-jiji.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.error: Gives one noun where there are many (jiti for majiti).

example.question: Miti mikubwa sana huitwa ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.cause: The child does not change the form for many.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.reveals: Singular and plural big forms in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.help: Count: one or many? Many takes ma-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.feedback: Wingi wa ukubwa hutumia ma-: majiti, majito, majiji, majitu.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.error: Gives the big form but keeps the agreement of the ordinary noun (jitu anakuja for jitu linakuja).

example.question: Jaza: Jitu ___ kuja.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.cause: The child changes the noun but not the verb.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.reveals: The question "Jaza: Jitu ___ kuja." with "anakuja" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.help: The big form moves to LI-YA: jitu li-, majitu ya-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.feedback: Nomino ya ukubwa huchukua upatanisho wa LI-YA: jitu linakuja.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.error: Gives the big form (ji-) for the small form (jiji for kijiji).

example.question: Mji mdogo sana huitwa ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.cause: The child mixes ji- (big) and ki- (small).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.help: Small is ki-. Big is ji-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.feedback: Udogo wa nomino hutumia ki-: kijiti, kijito, kijiji. Ukubwa hutumia ji-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.error: Keeps the noun as it is (mto mdogo for kijito).

example.question: Mto mdogo sana huitwa ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.cause: The child uses the adjective mdogo and does not change the noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.reveals: The plain noun as an option.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.help: Small form: the noun itself changes.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.feedback: Kuonyesha udogo, nomino yenyewe hubadilika: mto-kijito.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.error: Gives one noun where there are many (kijiti for vijiti).

example.question: Miti midogo sana huitwa ___.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.cause: The child does not change the form for many.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.reveals: Singular and plural small forms in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.help: Count: one or many? Many takes vi-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.feedback: Wingi wa udogo hutumia vi-: vijiti, vijito, vijiji, vijitu.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.error: Gives the small form but keeps the agreement of the ordinary noun (kijito umejaa for kijito kimejaa).

example.question: Jaza: Kijito ___ jaa maji.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.cause: The child changes the noun but not the verb.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kijito ___ jaa maji." with "umejaa" among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.help: The small form moves to KI-VI: kijito ki-, vijito vi-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.feedback: Nomino ya udogo huchukua upatanisho wa KI-VI: kijito kimejaa.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
